initial_plan.can_answer: yes: the data can describe the weekday distribution of police-reported crashes, but not crash risk by weekday
initial_plan.metric: number of crash rows by weekday
initial_plan.population: crashes with a usable crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025
initial_plan.years: 2013–2025 inclusive; whether endpoints are complete will be checked
initial_plan.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday

data_check.facts: check_1.csv records rows in each calendar year from 2013 to 2025, date coverage from January 1 through December 31 in every year, and zero NULL crash_date rows in the source. crash_date is typed DATE, so empty/unknown text and impossible calendar dates are not representable; no default date or unknown marker is documented for this column.
data_check.meaning_and_decisions: All 13 requested years are complete calendar years. No included crash rows are dropped for missing crash_date, and every included row maps to one weekday. Keep all rows and disclose that the records represent police-reported crashes, not exposure-adjusted risk. No plan change.

final_plan.can_answer: yes: describes the weekday distribution of police-reported crash records, not crash risk
final_plan.metric: number of crash rows by weekday, summed over calendar years 2013–2025
final_plan.denominator: no denominator; raw number of included crash rows
final_plan.population: all rows with crash_date in 2013–2025 inclusive
final_plan.years: all complete calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
final_plan.grouping: weekday derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday
final_plan.limitations: Zero source rows have NULL crash_date; DATE values cannot encode empty/unknown text or impossible dates, and no default or unknown marker is documented. No rows are excluded for the checked field. Counts reflect police-reported records, not traffic exposure or per-trip risk, and pooled counts weight years by their observed row totals.
